items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I did that one with Wymone Harris, which was a big hit.

ctx.x: And then he did a second one with the three trumpets playing all of Red's solos. That is the second version of that. And then we did "The Walk," "Who Threw The Whiskey In the Well?" I did that one with Wymone Harris, which was a big hit.

Uh huh. You know what we didn't mention? The Mills Blue Rhythm Band. Now that band was organized by Irving Mills, who was the song publisher and the manager -- and I heard that that band came about because of the success that Cab Calloway was having, and they wanted to follow it up like a second band, and so they all of them got Lucky Millinder, which was a personality like Cab Calloway, talked him into coming with the Mills Band. Was that so?
